items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles was appearing with his band at the Blackhawk or something with Frank Strozier

ctx.x: Some little painting [of] a bathroom, doing some garden work, things like that. I had an occasional teaching afternoon in San Jose sometimes. I would drive there and play some little gigs but nothing regular. Nothing terribly significant.

There was a thing in Ira Gitler’s book “Jazz Masters of the Forties” where he talks about [how] you told him there was a point where Miles was appearing with his band at the Blackhawk or something with Frank Strozier and Miles asked you to sit in. What happened there?
I just didn’t feel like doing that.
